:::{#exm-rct-identification}
#### Randomizing the severity example

Suppose the 1000 patients of @exm-exchangeability-strata
had instead been randomized,
each treated with probability 0.5 regardless of severity.
Then each treatment group has the population's severity mix,
60% non-severe and 40% severe
(treating proportions as probabilities),
so by consistency

$$
\ba
\E{Y \mid A = 1}
&= 0.6 \cdot 10 + 0.4 \cdot 20
&& \text{(severity mix of the treated; } \E{Y(1) \mid L} \text{)} \\
&= 14
&& \text{(multiply and add)} \\
\E{Y \mid A = 0}
&= 0.6 \cdot 8 + 0.4 \cdot 18
&& \text{(severity mix of the untreated; } \E{Y(0) \mid L} \text{)} \\
&= 12
&& \text{(multiply and add)}
\ea
$$

and @eq-rct-ate gives $\text{ATE} = 14 - 12 = 2$,
the treatment's effect in every stratum.

:::
